goal: Replace the neon palette with a theme-aware warm/OKLCH hue system across map, rooms, profiles and auth.
summary: Reconstructed from the staged diff by the handoff-setup session; the original session left no record. 33 files staged, not committed. NEON array → HUES keys (sage, clay, slate, ochre, plum, teal, rose, olive + neutral stone) rendered via CSS vars --hue-<key> defined per theme in app/globals.css. New lib/client/groupHues.ts assigns bubble hues from the full layout so neighbors differ; lib/client/palette.ts useHueHex() resolves vars to hex for canvas/SVG. components/ambient/NeonParticles.tsx deleted; Ambient.tsx is now a static paper-grain layer. Interest/identity colors come from interestHue(id).

decisions.what: Palette values live only in CSS (--hue-*), TS knows keys
decisions.why: Colors follow light/dark theme without re-render plumbing; canvas code resolves via useHueHex().

decisions.what: Bubble hue is assigned at render time, not stored
decisions.why: Keeps neighboring bubbles distinct as the layout changes; DB color column is a record-only swatch.
Warm redesign: static paper grain keeps focus on the map.

verification.typecheck: pass (npx tsc --noEmit on the staged tree, 2026-10-17, run by the handoff-setup session)

next_steps: Run `npm run lint` and `npm run dev`; check map, room, profile card, auth window in both light and dark themes.
